entries.page.title: Deal report
entries.depth.l1: Why: what was asked, proposed, approved and done
entries.depth.l2: Verify: the records, their places in the log and the checks
entries.shared.counterparty: A shared copy for the other party. Left out of this copy: {kinds}.
entries.shared.adjudicator: A shared copy for an adjudicator. Left out of this copy: {kinds}.
entries.rung.witnessed: Witnessed: the verifier checked a witness receipt in this file. Which steps that receipt covers is not shown here; capsulectl verify reports it. It does not confirm what the agent did.
entries.rung.unwitnessed: Sealed by my agent: no witness receipt is in this report.
entries.rung.witness_failed: A witness receipt is in this file and did not verify.
entries.countersign.none: Not countersigned: no other party has signed this record. It stands on the agent's own seal and any witness receipt above.
entries.countersign.some: Countersignatures, as the verifier reported them: {statuses}.
entries.section.proposed: What the agent proposed, and how it was checked
entries.section.statements.keep: What your agent told the buyer
entries.section.statements.counterparty: What the seller's agent told you
entries.section.statements.adjudicator: What the seller's agent told the buyer
entries.asked.opened: ✓ These are the exact words sealed when the deal opened.
entries.asked.committed: Your words are sealed as a commitment, and their opening is not in this copy, so they are not checked here.
entries.asked.mismatch: ⚠️ The words you asked could not be checked against the sealed record.
entries.asked.not_present: The deal's opening step is not in this report.
entries.statement.opened: ✓ These are the exact words sealed when the agent said them; this page does not check that they are true.
entries.statement.mismatch: ⚠️ A statement here could not be checked against its sealed step.
entries.statement.committed: A statement is sealed as a commitment; its opening is not in this copy.
entries.statement.withheld: A statement's step is withheld from this copy.
entries.statement.not_present: A statement's step is not in this report.
entries.summary.sealed: The text on this page was written by capsulectl when the receipt was made and sealed as a record in this file; the verifier checked that record. It is capsulectl's summary of the steps, not the steps themselves.
entries.summary.lines: The summary lines below, and each step's line, were written by capsulectl on this device and sealed with the receipt: they were checked as unchanged since, not that they are right. Open an item to see the steps it was read from; each step's sealed record is checked.
entries.merchant.none: No merchant email is attached to this receipt.
entries.merchant.intro: Two different things stand behind each email. The merchant's signature is checked against the merchant's published key, saved when the email was sealed; it shows what the merchant sent, and it does not depend on the agent. Our seal shows this device kept these exact bytes from that time on; it is our own record. Amounts, dates and order numbers below are read from the email by capsulectl and may be misread.
entries.merchant.key_supplied: The merchant's key was supplied by hand, not read from the merchant's DNS.
entries.merchant.charged: The merchant's email says (read from the email)
entries.merchant.key_size: Merchant's key (sealed when the email was sealed)
entries.told.none: Nothing about you was recorded as shared.
entries.told.note: Only what the agent sealed as shared is listed here; something it told without sealing it is not.
entries.claims.tamper: It is tamper-evident, not non-repudiation: it shows these records were not changed after they were sealed, not who made them.
entries.claims.reported: It records what the agent reported. It does not show that what was reported was true.
entries.claims.merchant: It does not prove the merchant shipped, delivered or refunded anything.
entries.claims.scope: The verification below covers every step's sealed record and its place in this deal's log. The records carry fingerprints, not names or numbers; the words shown come from the device that sealed them. The seal key is on the agent's machine, so this shows the record was not changed after it was made, not who made it. It covers this skill's own records only, never the agent host's own store.
entries.claims.withheld: Steps marked WITHHELD are proven present and unchanged, at their place in the log; what they say is not in this copy.
entries.step.no_log: no place in a log was supplied
entries.steps.summary: The steps this was read from
entries.provenance.unrecorded: an earlier capsulectl that did not record its version
entries.wording.provenance: This page's words: wording pack {id}, sha256 {sha}.
entries.rung.unreported: No witness result was reported to this page.
entries.l2.bundle_digest: The verifier's report is for the bundle with digest
entries.bilateral.title: Deal report: both parties' copies
entries.deal.mismatch: The copies name different deals ({deals}). They are not shown as one deal, and neither is picked.
entries.deal.unnamed: A copy names no deal, so the copies are not shown as one deal.
entries.party.heading: {role} copy ({member})
entries.parts.own: Each copy is shown from its own records. What one copy leaves out is never filled in from the other.
entries.joins.heading: How the two copies line up
entries.joins.none: The composition declares no join between the copies.
entries.join.result.join_state_mismatch: What was declared is not what the verifier derived.
entries.corroboration.corroborating: They agree, and their declared custody differs: corroborating, on declared custody only.
entries.corroboration.redundant: They agree, but redundantly, not corroborating ({reasons}).
entries.l2.composition: How the copies were put together, as the verifier checked it
